items.snippet: > [!IMPORTANT] > **The image-signing key has changed.** Starting with this release, every Docker image and Helm chart is signed with the new cosign key from commit [`e82a3c6`](https://github.com/BerriAI/litellm/commit/e82a3c646908ba0a6ee0beddc4310d7a6cac4065). Verifying with the previous key from commit `0112e53` will fail. > > Update anything that pins the old `cosign.pub`: `cosign verify` script
